text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Is this a Paka Petit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Kiseki is pointing,
there's a claw crane game filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There are so many kinds of Paka Petit nowadays~.
Oh, it looks like there are some familiar faces too...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, I've turned into a plushie~!?"
"And what's more, I'm trapped inside~!?"
...Just kidding. Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp! Wait a minute...
I might be able to use this idea for my next work...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
One day, the Umamusume turned into plushies
and found themselves trapped in a mysterious world—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "To regain their original bodies, the Umamusume fight to escape the world! But countless traps await our heroes!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: All that vision came from just this Paka-Petit...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? It's still just a rough draft,
but I think it has some originality to it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I brush this up, it might turn into a great piece!
Right, before I forget...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With eyes sparkling, Kiseki jots down notes on her ideas.
Here, I should...
choice_data_list: I'll win a Paka Petit for you as reference material.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
